skins.name: Midskog Fika
skins.description: Celebratory dress prepared by Valarqvin for a rare day of melted snow. Adorned with bright grass and flower motifs, which are infused with beautiful meaning in Sami .

skins.name: Bedtime Story
skins.description: Brigid's 'housewear' she chose for herself. Even if there's rarely a warm room to enjoy oneself in, it can still grant the hasty a moment of calm.

skins.name: To Evoke the Anima
skins.code: Achievement Star Collection/To Evoke the Anima
skins.description: Sesa loves games, especially sandbox survival ones with plenty of computer-wrecking bugs. Still, with the "Garb of the Soulseer", he can overcome any issue, somehow.

skins.name: Plush Cake
skins.description: On her off days, Dur-nar changes out of her well-worn battlefield clothes to try something a little more fun. She's well versed in balancing work and play, and an expert in enjoying life.

skins.name: Sweetness to the Heart
skins.code: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Sweetness to the Heart
skins.description: Outfit Nymph put together in preparation for the tea party. Light and comfortable, with just the right amount of sweetness. Maybe she has her own sugary secret recipe?
